name: cli-agent-runner
description: Run scoped Grok, Claude, Codex, or custom CLI workers with CLI Agent Runner and its default-on Codex IAB Live Console, started before workers. Trigger on CLI Agent Runner, Live Console, Grok/Claude CLI, custom runner JSON, or .cli-agent-runner continuation; explicit silent/no-console requests are the only OFF path; excludes generic coding and ordinary official subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Run scoped CLI workers with a default-on IAB Live Console.
interface.longDescription: CLI Agent Runner is an explicit process-runner workflow for scoped CLI workers. It bundles Codex, Claude, and Grok profiles, accepts additional or overridden profiles from runner JSON, invokes every profile through one validated command-and-arguments path, starts and opens one token-protected Codex IAB Live Console at skill selection before worker preparation, reuses it for later runners, streams emitted stdout/stderr or structured messages into it, enforces a machine-checkable repository scope, and records execution, parent artifact-acceptance, and result-contract outcomes independently in a process-runner-result packet under .cli-agent-runner. Direct runner commands also own a console by default; only explicit silent or no-console selection disables it. It does not replace generic coding or ordinary official-subagent routing.
capabilities: Codex, Claude, And Grok CLI Worker Launch
Default-On Prestarted Token-Protected IAB Live Console
Provider-Neutral Text And JSON Event Streaming
Separated Execution, Artifact-Acceptance, And Result-Contract Outcomes
defaultPrompt: Use CLI Agent Runner to start and open its Live Console before project work, then launch a scoped Codex, Claude, Grok, or configured CLI worker and return its process-runner-result.
Start CLI Agent Runner Live Console in Codex IAB first, keep it standing by, and later stream a scoped Grok worker into it.
Add or use a custom CLI runner from JSON for this .cli-agent-runner task.
